title: Migrate implementation loop source root
summary: Move implementation compiler/gate/tool/type and publication ownership toward src/implementation without introducing publish or validation roots.

goal.outcome: Implementation loop source ownership is visible under src/implementation with compiler/gate/tool/type surfaces and publication kept under implementation.
acceptance: src/implementation/** contains implementation compiler/gate/tool/type entrypoints or direct owner modules for implementation-loop behavior.
Publication/task-close/ship-ready criteria remain modeled under implementation, not a publish or validation loop root.
Existing public/API/tool behavior remains compatible after migration.
Tests cover implementation build/gate contract, publication-under-implementation invariant, and source-contract expectations for the implementation root.
No decision-loop or planning-loop ownership is moved into src/implementation.
non_goals: Do not implement planning root migration.
Do not create src/validation or src/publish roots.
Do not add CodeWiki-repo-specific dogfood behavior.
verification: targeted TASK-118 implementation root migration test

delta.desired: src/implementation owns implementation-loop compiler/gate/tool/type and publication criteria surfaces.
delta.current: Implementation behavior and gate criteria are spread across build/gateway/policy/checks compatibility surfaces; src/implementation root is missing or not owner-complete.
delta.closure: Closed when implementation root exists with tests and source-contract evidence.
